name: Using AI Safely: Data Handling for Every Employee
description: A plain-language course on handling data safely with AI tools: what happens to what you type or upload, how to classify before you paste, how connected apps and agents change the picture, and how to report a mistake quickly.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Using AI Safely: Data Handling for Every Employee

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 15 lessons in 5 modules; and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 30 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
